stories.title: Sources: LSU closes roster at 105 without adding ex-NFL players
stories.summary: After a judge allowed the return of former NFL players to LSU, the Tigers on Tuesday added two current student-athletes to the roster, closing it at 105, sources told ESPN's Pete Thamel, eliminating the ability to add Dae'Quan Wright and Zxavian Harris.

stories.title: NCAA issues new guidance on 'standard timing protocol' in wake of U-M win
stories.summary: The NCAA is establishing a new standard timing protocol in the wake of the controversial decision to award Michigan an extra second despite the broadcast clock showing zeros.

stories.title: Tiafoe, Michelsen share emotional moment after 5-set US Open battle
stories.summary: After handing his fellow American a crushing defeat in the US Open quarterfinals Tuesday, Frances Tiafoe held Alex Michelsen in a long embrace while the 22-year-old sobbed on his shoulder.

stories.title: Bucs, Mayfield reach 3-year, $165M extension, sources say
stories.summary: The Buccaneers and quarterback Baker Mayfield agreed to a three-year, $165 million extension, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: 49ers starting DT Collins tears patellar tendon in Australia, out for year
stories.summary: 49ers starting defensive tackle Alfred Collins suffered a torn patellar tendon in the team's Tuesday practice in Australia, an injury that will keep him out for the 2026 season.
